translations.web: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,
translations.bsb: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge his brother, the wife he embraces, and the rest of his children who have survived,
